rationale: The revision adopts the one change my comparison said had to be carried forward regardless of which pin won — the exact-turn collision, now resolved by a single shared resolveTurnPhase helper on both attribution paths, with a focused test and a doc update — and I verified it by execution: lint and typecheck clean, 76 tests green across the five suites it touches, token figures on the real issue-121 runtime byte-identical to the compared pin, 187 Codex tool calls that were previously folded into the first action with exact coverage now labelled as an explicit shared-turn fallback, legacy runs still fail closed for run and status with the wipe message, and a malformed terminal gate-advanced still errors instead of reporting a stretched elapsed time; the two items it left open (the cursors.json completion gate with its raw ENOENT, and the bundled rather than per-gap tests) produce no wrong number and are additive follow-ups, not blockers.
